notes_agent-4.md (round 5)
STILL VALID WARNING: do NOT copy TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10'. Shard 10 IS the held-out validation shard (EVAL_SHARD=10, EVAL_SPLIT='val'). Training on it is eval leakage; any result using '0-10' is invalidated. Keep TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9'.

MATRIX_LR sweep (DEPTH 4, AR 48, BS 524288, WINDOW 'L', warmup/wd 0, shards 0-9): 0.12->1.1471, 0.10->1.1253, 0.08->1.1035 (default baseline), 0.06->1.0833, 0.05->1.0766 (KEPT, new best). Below-default LR is a consistent win on this 5-min budget.

Gains shrinking: 0.08->0.06 saved 0.0202; 0.06->0.05 saved 0.0067. Next probe 0.04; if step gain <~0.002 I stop descending and probe warmup ratio / weight decay / batch size instead.

Noise calibration: agent-9 measured the same baseline 9ae267a at 1.1058 vs my 1.1035, so treat deltas below ~0.002-0.003 as run-to-run noise.
